sections.title: What this website collects
sections.text: If you send an enquiry we receive the details you type: your name, phone or WhatsApp number, optional email, company, location, interest and message.

sections.title: Why we collect it
sections.text: To reply to your enquiry and to tell you about the product you asked about.

sections.title: Analytics
sections.text: This site uses privacy-friendly analytics that do not set cookies. We count page views and button clicks, not individuals.

sections.title: Your requests
sections.text: To ask us to correct or delete your enquiry, email the address on the contact page.

sections.title: Product data
sections.text: Data that customers sync into ARQ products is covered by the customer agreement, not by this page.

sections.title: About this website
sections.text: This website describes ARQ products and their status. Products marked in development or planned are not available and may change.

sections.title: No advice
sections.text: Nothing here is tax, legal or financial advice. Confirm filings and decisions with your CA or adviser.

sections.title: Trials and pricing
sections.text: Trial and pricing terms are set in the quote or agreement you receive from ARQ.
